outcome.technical: tools/gate-parity.py, _verify_cleanup_cases (control block, around line 3636-3660). Before: the vsh5 control ran only if dash was on PATH; otherwise check('vsh5 SKIPPED HERE ...', dash is None) printed PASS from a hand-written always-true condition. Now: the RETURN-trap control is run under the shell the cases actually ran under (dash if present, else sh), not under dash by name. If it leaves exactly one directory, it is a real control and passes (check, same label as before, 'under <shell>'). Otherwise it calls the house helper `_harness.skip(check, 'vsh5', mechanism, absent=len(left)==0)` (plugins/audit/tests/_harness.py:423, imported inside the function after `from _suite import remove_tree` has put tests/ on sys.path). skip() is the suite's skip vocabulary: label 'vsh5 SKIPPED HERE - ...' and it FAILS when absent is false. The skip text says vsh2-vsh4 and vsh9 could not have seen the defect on this shell and to install dash. Requirement clauses: (1) 'use the skip vocabulary if the suite has one' -> done, _harness.skip, gate-parity.py around 3650; (2) vsh2-vsh4 running under a shell where a RETURN trap works -> not made to fail or be skipped individually, because the control is the single statement that says they could not see the defect; the vsh5 skip line names vsh2-vsh4 and vsh9 explicitly; per-case skips were not done because that shell may still catch the defect through other paths (vsh6, vsh7, vsh8 do not depend on the RETURN trap); (3) a control that did not run must not print PASS unlabelled -> the skip label carries SKIPPED HERE and an unexpected directory count fails. Evidence: `python3 tools/gate-parity.py --selftest` exit 0, 143/143, vsh5 real control under dash on this machine. Scratch driver (scratchpad/probe50.py, outside the repo) with shutil.which('dash') patched to None: sh here honours the trap (left=[]), output 'PASS vsh5 SKIPPED HERE - under sh ... left 0 directories behind ... install dash', 143/143. Same driver with the control's result forced to two directories: 'FAIL vsh5 SKIPPED HERE ... (skipped on a platform that HAS this mechanism ...)', exit 1, 142/143. `ruff check tools/gate-parity.py` exit 0. `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py --quiet` run in the foreground in the task tree: exit 0, 335/335 files ok, 16634 cases. Did not run capture-screenshots, check-report-interactive or verify.sh, per the addendum. HEAD before first edit: 1d97cd45.
outcome.descriptive: gate-parity's vsh5 control now runs under the shell the cleanup cases used and, where that shell cannot show the defect, reports a labelled skip through the house helper (failing on an unexpected result) instead of a hand-written always-true PASS.
